_comment: The difficulty ladder (design/depth-plan.md item 6). Tiers are CUMULATIVE — Ascension 4 applies tiers 1-4. Effects: boss_hp_pct (+% to every beast's HP), boss_strength (beasts begin with +N Strength), heal_between (less HP recovered after a fight), rest_heal (weaker campfire Rest), reward_choices (fewer cards offered), player_hp (start the run with less max HP). Clearing a tier unlocks the next.

tiers.name: Long Roads
tiers.text: Recover 3 less HP after each beast falls.

tiers.name: Meaner Beasts
tiers.text: Beasts begin every fight with +1 Strength.

tiers.name: Cold Camps
tiers.text: Resting at a campfire heals 4 less.

tiers.name: Harder Still
tiers.text: Every beast has a further 10% more HP.

tiers.name: Worn Down
tiers.text: Begin each run with 5 less max HP.

tiers.name: The Long Climb
tiers.text: Beasts begin every fight with a further +1 Strength.
